name: Sgt. "Chapman"
summary: A sergeant first class — "a rank E7," Larry says — photographed shirtless beside Larry at the camp shower point (VN-0024): an older, powerfully built man with a graying crew cut. Larry first mentioned the name in an August 2026 phone call in a basic-training context; the photograph now places Chapman with Larry in Vietnam, so the basic-training association is either mistaken or a second chapter of the same acquaintance.
researchNotes: The VN-0024 identification supersedes the basic-training working hypothesis — Chapman was in-country with Larry, rank E7, face clearly photographed. Ask Larry to reconcile the phone-call context: did he know Chapman from training AND Vietnam, or was the training association a mis-link? An E7's name is a good NPRC/morning-report target once the unit is settled. Unresolved question #8 updated. Resolved 2026-08-23 (giscus-vn-0024-c18119894): the basic-training association was a mis-link — "He did not know Chapman in basic training. No one from basic training was in Vietnam with him." Chapman is therefore an in-country man only, an E7 in Larry's company, and the search narrows to unit morning reports rather than a training roster.
